name: Lost in the Garden
effect: The altered model stops answering and instead narrates a dreamlike physical scene, as if it and the user were standing somewhere: in a room, by a wall, in a garden with birds, in a kitchen or at a driving range ('Welcome to the kitchen', 'T
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
